turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start going to the gym but honestly I'm terrified of looking stupid.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lots of people feel exactly that. Most people at the gym are too busy with their own workout to notice anyone else.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't even know how to use the machines.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Many gyms offer a free induction where a staff member shows you around. It's worth asking for.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What should I do on day one?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it short. Ten minutes on a bike or treadmill, then three or four machines with the instructions printed on them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could I go at a quiet time?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, mid morning or early afternoon is usually calm. Late evenings on weekends too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And headphones, so nobody talks to me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Headphones are the universal do not disturb sign. Good plan.
